catalogDescription: Create reusable forms from a template, then edit fields and languages.
requestError: Unable to save. Your changes are still here; try again.
emptyHint: Choose Contact, Newsletter or Owner profitability above. Each form has independent fields and copy.
placementLater: These forms can be tested by staff. Selecting a form for a public page will be added with the visual page editor. Existing public forms remain separate.
editorDescription: Select a field in the preview to edit its content and rules.
archivedHint: Archived form. Restore it from the catalog before saving or testing.
conflict: A newer version was saved. Your draft is still here. Open this form in another tab to compare before reloading.
saveSourceFirst: Save the EN source before saving translations.
unsavedHint: You have unsaved changes. Test mode uses only the saved version.
savedTestHint: Staff test of saved revision {revision}. Submitting records test data and attempts an email to {recipient}. Approved translations are used; missing or unapproved texts fall back to EN.
canvasHint: Select the heading, a step or a field. This canvas edits your draft; it does not send data.
targetHint: Edit translated text here. Structure and rules are shared and edited in EN. Empty translations use EN.
label: Label
removeStepHint: Removing a step moves its fields to the first remaining step.
recipientHint: One mailbox for this form. The sender is configured on the server.
title: Form title

delivery.accepted: Test recorded. Resend accepted the email; final delivery is not confirmed.
delivery.logged: Test recorded in the local email console. No email was sent.
delivery.skipped: Test recorded. Email is disabled; no email was sent.
delivery.failed: Test recorded, but the email attempt failed. Check the server configuration before trying again.
